verdict.rationale: Phaser is a code-first JS/TS library installed via npm, and editor projects can be moved to VS Code, which suggests builds can be driven by standard command-line tooling rather than an editor. However, no evidence documents an actual headless build or export command or a CI workflow, and the only official CLI shown is an interactive template scaffolder that asks questions. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive build/export command, CI pipeline guidance, headless export to target platforms (native exports rely on 3rd-party tools), and hands-on corroboration.
